title: Road Helper Trucks for Kids! Rollers, Loaders and More
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're meeting five trucks that build roads and keep them clean.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Listen for the clues, and see if you can guess each truck first!

lines: Here's our first stop. Here's a clue: it has a bucket in front and a digging arm in back! Can you guess?
A backhoe loader is like two machines in one!
The big bucket in front scoops up dirt and loads it into trucks.
The arm in the back is called a backhoe. It digs deep holes.
Can you scoop in front and dig in back? Scoop! Dig!
Can you guess how the driver uses the arm in the back?
The driver's seat turns all the way around to face it!
Let's say it together: BACKHOE LOADER!
One more time, nice and loud: BACKHOE LOADER!
Backhoe loaders are small enough to work on busy town streets.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has a giant heavy drum instead of front wheels! Can you guess?
A road roller helps build brand-new roads.
Its big round drum is very, very heavy.
It rolls slowly back and forth, back and forth, over the new road.
Can you roll your arms round and round like a big drum?
Can you guess why the road roller is so heavy?
Its heavy drum presses the road flat and smooth!
Let's say it together: ROAD ROLLER!
One more time, nice and loud: ROAD ROLLER!
Water sprays on the drum, so the warm road does not stick to it.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has a bucket that lifts a worker way up high! Can you guess?
A cherry picker is a truck with a long, bendy arm.
Workers ride up in the bucket to fix tall streetlights, like this one!
The arm bends and stretches to lift the bucket up, up, up.
Can you bend your arm and stretch it up high?
Can you guess where the funny name cherry picker comes from?
Long ago, lifts like this helped farmers pick fruit from tall trees!
Let's say it together: CHERRY PICKER!
One more time, nice and loud: CHERRY PICKER!
Cherry pickers also help trim tall trees and hang holiday lights.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it has spinning brushes that clean the street! Can you guess?
A street sweeper keeps our town clean and tidy.
Round brushes spin underneath to sweep up dirt and leaves.
It scoops everything into a big box inside the truck.
Can you pretend to sweep with a broom? Swish, swish!
Can you guess why the street sweeper sprays water?
A little water keeps the dust from flying up into the air!
Let's say it together: STREET SWEEPER!
One more time, nice and loud: STREET SWEEPER!
Street sweepers often clean very early in the morning.
Who's last? Here's a clue: it has a giant blade for pushing snow! Can you guess?
A snowplow clears the roads on snowy days.
Its big curved blade pushes the snow off to the side of the road.
Bright flashing lights help everyone see it coming.
Can you push the snow with your hands? Push, push, push!
Can you guess what the snowplow sprinkles from the back?
Salt and sand! They help keep the road from getting icy.
One more time, nice and loud: SNOWPLOW!
Snowplows often work all night, so the roads are ready by morning.

recap: What hard-working road helpers! Let's remember.
The backhoe loader's seat turns all the way around.
The road roller makes the road flat and smooth.
The cherry picker lifts workers up high.
The street sweeper sprays water to stop the dust.
And the snowplow pushes snow and spreads salt!
outro: Which road helper was your favorite? Be kind, and wave hello to the workers you see.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
